releaseNotes.zh: 修复助手启动后立即暂停的问题。无需邀请码即可申请、查看免费 AI 点数；移除邀请码后恢复原有免费额度。支持的 Android 设备可完成系统校验后领取。主动反馈时附带具体失败阶段。覆盖安装保留本地数据，更新不会重复赠送点数。
releaseNotes.en: Fixes an assistant startup failure. Claim and view free AI credits without an invitation, and restore an existing free-credit identity after removing one. Supported Android devices can claim after system verification. Voluntary reports include precise failure stages. Install over the existing app to retain local data; updating does not repeat a credit grant.
